associations.rationale: The formal type directly gives an equivalence from twoRep i j 0 to the direct sum of simpleRep i and simpleRep j, exactly stating the zero-coefficient splitting clause.
The formal type failed to pretty print, so the packet does not expose the hypotheses needed to verify a direct match to the distinct-vertex, nonzero-coefficient indecomposability clause.

The formal type states only that twoRep i j 0 is not indecomposable; this is a consequence compatible with the splitting clause, not the source's direct-sum statement or its nonzero-coefficient assertion.
